title: Talk 1
original: The most important thing my safta taught me was that life shouldn't have too many taboos.

title: Talk 2
original: Focus on the work at hand and don't jump to any conclusions.

title: Talk 3
original: Tachanka's taught me a thing or two about how to build defenses.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I have some questions, Doctor. I hope you can answer them for me.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Overcoming obstacles and breaking down barriers makes a lot of things easier.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I'm willing to try, as long as the reward is commensurate to the risk.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: You think I'm strict, huh? I'll take that as a compliment.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Do me a favor. You worry about the strategy and let me worry about the tactics.

title: Onboard
original: Rainbow Operator, codename Ash. I have my authorization and I'm ready for assignment.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: The more we can learn about their attack patterns, the better off we'll be.

title: Promotion 2
original: You can't really understand a conflict until you've been on both sides.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Let's get our heads in the game.

title: Depart
original: Let's show them what we can do.

title: 4-star Result
original: That worked out better than I expected.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: We knew the risks. We still have to see this through.
